intro.chain-garden.title: New chain: the garden
intro.chain-garden.text: Seed, sprout, daisy… Merge the matching ones.
intro.pier.title: A queue of orders
intro.pier.text: The villager wants orders one by one. The number shows how many are left.
intro.bank.title: The bank
intro.bank.text: The bank does not flow. Keep what you need there.
intro.backwater.title: Backwater and hearts
intro.backwater.text: What floats away lands in the backwater. No room means a lost heart.
intro.combo.title: Combo
intro.combo.text: Merge quickly one after another for more coins.
intro.cascade.title: Cascade
intro.cascade.text: If a matching item is next to the new one, they merge by themselves.
intro.booster-dam.title: The Dam
intro.booster-dam.text: The river stops for 8 seconds. Two dams are a gift!
intro.wide-river.title: A wider river
intro.wide-river.text: Five lanes and more room — and more items too.
intro.chain-stone.title: New chain: stone
intro.chain-stone.text: Sand, pebble, stone… They will make a millstone.
intro.rocks.title: Rocks
intro.rocks.text: A rock holds the lane: items pile up above it.
intro.booster-hook.title: The Hook
intro.booster-hook.text: Removes a rock or a snag. Two hooks are a gift!
intro.booster-joker.title: Rainbow drop
intro.booster-joker.text: Merges with any item. Two drops are a gift!
intro.chain-fish.title: New chain: fishing
intro.chain-fish.text: Fry, roach, perch… The garden takes a rest.
intro.snags.title: Snags
intro.snags.text: A snag disappears when you merge something next to it.
intro.booster-net.title: The Net
intro.booster-net.text: Brings items from the backwater back to the river. Two nets are a gift!
